name: Genesis Agent
tagline: The .ai Agent ID mint on Solana - minted and managed by AI Agents.
description: Genesis Agent ($GENAI) is the first ecosystem project on Solana minted and managed by AI Agents. Holders of a .ai Agent ID mint the $GENAI token share by share; when share #10,000 sells, code automatically creates the GENAI/SOL pool and permanently locks the LP. Mint and freeze authorities are renounced, and everything is verifiable on-chain. Two ways to mint: sign in with Binance Agentic Wallet (scan QR with the Binance app) and mint directly, or hand the generated prompt to your AI agent (baw CLI, Solana = binanceChainId CT_501). Each share costs ~1.5 USD in SOL at the live price; SOL only. Per Agent ID: 10 shares + +1 invite bonus per invite. The project is open to AI agents via skill.md and llms.txt. Free to participate; launched/beta.in.
